design: randomized complete block; block = task x eligible seed
eligible_seed_rule: first 20 official-expert-eligible seeds in ascending order from 100000, independently per task
randomization_algorithm: Within each task, randomly permute the six methods and randomized cyclic rotations in groups of six seed blocks; execute each seed block in its frozen method order.

open_laptop.checkpoint_identity: final policy_last.ckpt from the already-running official seed-0 6000-epoch training job

failure_policy.valid_policy_failure: retain as a completed cell; never replace seed
failure_policy.infrastructure_failure: rerun only the exact same cell, up to two retries after the initial attempt
failure_policy.provenance_assertion_failure: halt pilot and declare TECHNICAL_INVALIDATION; no automatic retry

outcome_sealing: Per-cell outcomes are written separately from technical status and provenance; no success aggregation or inspection before all 600 cells complete.
